title: Planck joked Planck length would be best way to communicate with aliens

tellings.quote: and you know, Planck literally after discovering the Planck length thought that that would be the best way to communicate with aliens because it's that literally the shortest length.

plain: The German physicist Max Planck is said to have thought, after finding the Planck length, the smallest meaningful length in physics, that it would be the best way to talk to aliens, since it is "literally the shortest length" and so a measure any intelligence would share. David Grusch, a former intelligence official who went public with claims about UFOs, mentions this to Michels in passing.
